ghi_chu.mo_ta: On the skyline at right, a Gothic church with a tall square crenellated tower has a separate slender pointed spire beside it. It looks like a generic cathedral. It does not show Old St Paul's very long nave with a squat crossing tower.
ghi_chu.ly_do: Old St Paul's had a square crossing tower with no spire, because the spire was lost in 1561. It also had a very long nave. The pointed spire and the tower shape here do not match its 1666 form.
